page: Amazon Web Services r9gd.metal-48xl is a memory-optimized bare-metal server powered by AWS Graviton processors. It features 192 dedicated physical cores on the arm64 architecture, operating at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz with a single thread per core. The system is equipped with 1536.0 GB of system memory, providing a ratio of 8.0 GB of RAM per physical core.

This server includes 11400 GB of local NVMe SSD instance storage, offering high-capacity, low-latency local data access. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 100 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput data transfers and low network latency. There are no integrated GPUs on this instance type.

The bare-metal configuration eliminates virtualization overhead, maximizing resource density and efficiency for large-scale deployments. The combination of high memory capacity, extensive local NVMe SSD storage, and energy-efficient Graviton arm64 cores makes this server highly cost-efficient for memory-intensive and storage-heavy workloads. It is designed for large-scale databases, in-memory caching systems, big data analytics, and high-throughput enterprise applications.
